caseName: Full Salvation Union v. Portage Township
caseNameFull: Full Salvation Union v. Portage Township
attorneys: Burton Allen Andrews for appellants. Lewis George Meader and Harry F. Smith for appellee.
judges: Hearing, Merits, Murphy, Noted, Postponed, Question, Rutledge, Should, That

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Murphy is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted. Mr. Justice Rutledge is of the opinion that the question of jurisdiction should be postponed to a hearing of the case on the merits.
